title: The Nihilist Reading Of Jujutsu Kaisen (TV series) #Shorts
description:
The feeling that Jujutsu Kaisen (TV series) means something is a chemical event with an evolutionary address. Jujutsu Kaisen (呪術廻戦; rgh. 'Sorcery Battle') is a Japanese anime television series produced by MAPPA, based on the manga series Jujutsu Kaisen by Gege Akutami. The story focuses on high school student Yuji Itadori as he joins a secret organization of Jujutsu Sorcerers to eliminate a powerful Sorcerer named Ryomen Sukuna, of whom Yuji becomes the host.

The nihilist does not deny Jujutsu Kaisen (TV series) — he only refuses to flatter it. In 2023, Jujutsu Kaisen became one of three recipients of the Special Achievement Award at the 65th Japan Record Awards. In 2024, it won the "Most In-Demand TV Series in the World 2023" and "Most In-Demand Anime Series of 2023" at the sixth Global Demand Awards.
